item.title: Unlocking a locked/deactivated e-waste Cricut Maker
item.description:
📝 Alex did some quick searching and found that replacement rollers were readily available for very few dollarbucks. When it detects a packet from the cutter that matches the right length, and has the command / serial number in it, it replaces it out with a different serial number. I could even register serial numbers that didn’t exist on the Cricut machine status page.
🔗 Read more: https://sprocketfox.io/xssfox/2026/07/01/cricut-unlock/

item.title: Introducing MicroLighter
item.description:
